primary_target: UAS-view major damage or destroyed building; not injured persons or ground-survey truth
eligible_geometry: Shared IDs whose centroids lie inside fixed ROI; rasterized polygon at least90% inside ROI and at least90% supported by nonblack RGB in every source.
coverage: RGB-nonzero image support proxy, not proof of visibility or camera footprint
gates: If zero eligible primary targets, do not compare severe-search efficacy or claim a method contribution.

routing_if_eligible.actions: 4x4 disjoint32m image access windows; no measured UAV camera footprint
routing_if_eligible.public_features: Published footprint geometry, fixed model outputs on PRE/POST satellite pair; never reference labels.
routing_if_eligible.paid_observation: Fixed model PRE/UAS output only within accessed window; unrevealed UAS data private.
routing_if_eligible.cost: Euclidean motion plus observation and planning charges, paid return; all timing assumptions reported separately from measured distances.
baselines: exact subset static on same public utility
routing_if_eligible.candidate: Observation-value/cost heuristic must use public inputs only; uncertainty scores are uncalibrated. No learned update without separate calibration data.
metrics: time to first correctly checked severe building
routing_if_eligible.fairness: Same starts,budgets,observation footprints,detector and return constraints; full subset enumeration/static optimum and planning wall time reported.

data_scope: One training development region. No held-out generalization; satellite/UAS time gap5days; no flight telemetry.
